coordinates: Unity world: x right, y up, z forward; no axis conversion
geometryScope: Active-scene enabled MeshRenderers, highest LOD, opaque submeshes only
triangleLayout: triangles.i32: little-endian int32 global vertex indices, three per triangle
notes: No visibility/shadow evaluation. No terrain, particles, decals, or shader vertex displacement.
Normals are inverse-transpose transformed vertex normals; tangents/normal maps are not exported.
No visibility filtering of buried/back surfaces. No scene or light settings modified.
